Policy Manual Updates

Update to Chapter 5: Discretion

USCIS is updating guidance in the USCIS Policy Manual to clarify how USCIS exercises discretion when adjudicating requests for Optional Practical Training (OPT) extensions for F-1 students.

Update to Chapter 3: Trafficking Victims

USCIS is updating guidance regarding T nonimmigrant status for victims of a severe form of trafficking in persons.

Clarifying STEM OPT Extension Employer Obligations

Clarifies employer training plan obligations under the STEM OPT 24-month extension for F-1 students in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics fields.
